title: 2.4.22 Fix the Infinite Loop
description: A chart arrives whose diamond only has one exit — the loop can never leave. Add the missing branch so a reader can see where it stops.
sourceRef: designed — practice diagnosing an infinite loop on a chart, mirrors the 2.2.14 'Fix the Broken Chart' pattern

diagram.starter:
flowchart TD
  A([Start]) --> B[count = 5]
  B --> C{count > 0}
  C -- yes --> D[print count]
  D --> E[count = count - 1]
  E --> C
